company_description: Alpenglow Ticketless builds a cloud-native support automation layer that drives ticket deflection for mid-market ecommerce and SMB platforms. Heavy chat and email ingestion, prioritizes near-zero live chat latency and best-in-class top-5 result quality for automated responders.
notes:
Summary and technical snapshot:
- Primary ask: RAG for agent + ticket deflection. Tight latency SLOs for live chat (customer insists on <=200ms retrieval+rerank p95 for 'fast path' cases; agnostic to slightly higher p95 for long-context archival searches).
- Scale expectations: indexing target at POC: 120M short passages (~1B tokens), steady state 250M passages. Freshness: hourly nearline updates for tickets and KBs.
- Retrieval architecture preference: bi-encoder embeddings for vector search + lightweight cross-encoder reranker for top-5 precision. Want options: on-device quantized reranker (<=1B params) or dedicated cross-attention runner if necessary.
- Latency targets and cost constraints: target cost per query <$0.02 (end-to-end retrieval+rerank); prefer batching/caching to reduce per-token cost. p95 <= 200ms for hot-path, p99 budgeted to 500ms with graceful fallback to cached summaries.
- Model preferences: open/quantized embedding encoder (SBERT-style or instruction-tuned open models) + cross-encoder reranker (distilled cross-encoders preferred). Will consider Redwood-verified model profiles.
- Deployment & security: must sit in customer VPC for Dedicated or Private plane; KMS-managed keys required; SSO via SAML mandatory; audit logging and 13-month retention for logs. Data residency: primary in US, EU read-only mirrors.
- POC plan (agreed on 2026-02-18):
  * Week 0 (kickoff 2026-01-20): share sample corpus (20M passages) + SLA matrix.
  * Week 2: initial embedding index on Dedicated small cluster, run 10k queries, measure recall@5 and latency.
  * Week 4: scale index to 120M passages, enable KV/prefix caching, run traffic shaped to production pattern (concurrent 250 qps) and capture p95/p99.
  * Week 6: evaluate reranker candidate models, compare top-5 quality (manual eval set + NDCG/MRR), show cost/Q tradeoffs.
- Recent activity (timeline):
  * 2026-01-20: Kickoff call — demo of current search infra, sent sample dataset and Fireflies transcript (FF-9382-2026-01-20).
  * 2026-02-03: Security touchpoint — initial KMS requirements, legal NDA draft in drive.
  * 2026-02-10: Technical deep-dive with ML eng (Rohan present) — confirmed 120M target, concurrency profile, ingest cadence.
  * 2026-02-18: POC scope confirmed, Redwood to deliver Dedicated baseline config + cost/Q projections (FF-10420-2026-02-18).
- Quotes / customer color: "Need under 200ms for live chat — anything slower we route to human triage" (Sr. Eng). Finance: "we need predictable cost per query to model micro-SLA charges to customers".
- Requirements & concerns:
  * Must prove reranker improves top-5 helpful rate by >12% vs current BM25+emb baseline.
  * Concern about embedding storage cost at 250M vectors; asking for deduping/compression guidance.
  * Want automated fallback to smaller model if Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Next steps (short):
  * Redwood to provide cluster sizing + cost estimate for Dedicated POC (due 2026-03-07).
  * Rohan to share evaluation set (5k labeled pairs) and current BM25/emb baseline metrics.
  * Legal to finish KMS addendum (pending).
- Notes style: shorthand, fragments — internal AE checklist appended to drive/pricing.
- Links referenced: pricing deck (drive link above), security FAQ draft, evaluation set (internal share).
